validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <initial><transition target="a1"/></initial>
    <initial><transition target="a2"/></initial>
    <onentry>
      <send event="report">
        <content>first</content>
        <content>second</content>
      </send>
    </onentry>
    <invoke type="http://www.w3.org/TR/scxml/">
      <content expr="'child.scxml'"/>
      <content expr="'other.scxml'"/>
      <finalize><log expr="'one'"/></finalize>
      <finalize><log expr="'two'"/></finalize>
    </invoke>
    <state id="a1"><transition event="go" target="done"/></state>
    <state id="a2"><transition event="go" target="done"/></state>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<state>` has 2 `<initial>` children, but allows at most one
notes: a `<state>` has at most one `<initial>`: it is the one default entry transition of the state
diagnostics.help: keep one `<initial>`; to enter several parallel descendants, list them all as targets of its one `<transition>`

diagnostics.message: `<send>` has 2 `<content>` children, but allows at most one
notes: `<send>` carries at most one `<content>`: it is the whole event payload, so a second one has no meaning
diagnostics.help: keep the one `<content>` that is the payload; to send several values, use `<param>` children or one structured `<content>`

diagnostics.message: `<invoke>` has 2 `<content>` children, but allows at most one
notes: `<invoke>` takes at most one inline `<content>`: it is the one document the invoked service runs
diagnostics.help: keep the one `<content>` that is the service's document

diagnostics.message: `<invoke>` has 2 `<finalize>` children, but allows at most one
notes: `<invoke>` takes at most one `<finalize>`: it is the one block that processes each event the invoked service returns
diagnostics.help: merge the executable content into one `<finalize>`

secondary.message: targeted here, but `a` ignores this `<initial>`, so it never runs

notes: reachability assumes every event can arrive and every `cond` can be true; no reachable transition, `initial`, or history default enters this state or any of its descendants
diagnostics.help: target `a2` from a transition of a reachable state, make it the initial state of `a`, or remove it
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §3.11 Legal State Configurations and Specifications
